text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى

translations.asad: EXTOL the limitless glory of thy Sustainer's name: [the glory of] the Al-Highest,
translations.sahih: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

translations.asad: who creates [every thing], and thereupon forms it in accordance with what it is meant to be,
and who determines the nature [of all that exists], and thereupon guides it [towards its fulfilment],

translations.sahih: And who brings out the pasture

translations.asad: and thereupon causes it to decay into rust-brown stubble!
WE SHALL teach thee, and thou wilt not forget [aught of what thou art taught],
translations.sahih: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,

text.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ

translations.asad: save what God may will [thee to forget] - for, verily, He [alone] knows all that is open to [man's] perception as well as all that is hidden [from it]
translations.sahih: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

translations.asad: and [thus] shall We make easy for thee the path towards [ultimate] ease.
translations.sahih: And We will ease you toward ease.

translations.asad: REMIND, THEN, [others of the truth, regardless of] whether this reminding [would seem to] be of use [or not]:
translations.sahih: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;

translations.asad: in mind will keep it he who stands in awe [of God],
translations.sahih: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.

translations.asad: but aloof from it will remain that most hapless wretch –
translations.sahih: But the wretched one will avoid it -

translations.asad: he who [in the life to come] shall have to endure the great fire
translations.sahih: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

text.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ

translations.asad: wherein he will neither die nor remain alive.
To happiness [in the life to come] will indeed attain he who attains to purity [in this world],
translations.sahih: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

translations.asad: and remembers his Sustainer's name, and prays [unto Him].
translations.sahih: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

translations.asad: But nay, [O men,] you prefer the life of this world,
translations.sahih: But you prefer the worldly life,

translations.asad: although the life to come is better and more enduring.
translations.sahih: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

translations.asad: Verily, [all] this has indeed been [said] in the earlier revelations –
translations.sahih: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

translations.asad: the revelations of Abraham and Moses.
translations.sahih: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
